title: 第25章 灵车第26章 海边悬崖
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 郑常躺在车上，舒服得想要打盹。
灵石驱动法车法器！灵宝商会出品。
半智能全自动驾驶，可事先设定行进路线，亦可设定自动巡航模式，随机选择地图中可行进道路。
会识别危险路况，通知使用者，有应急防御模式，可在一定时间内抵挡筑基期修士攻击，保护使用者安全。
能耗低，巡航模式运行一日消耗不过五块灵石，防御模式全功率运转，每小时也不过耗费十五灵石。
有灵石可运转，无灵石依靠修士供应灵气亦可运转。
整车可收入中号储物袋，不用担心找不到停车位。
舒适配饰和强力减震使你旅途中轻松惬意。
全车落地价，仅一千下品灵石，性价比之王。
可以说，除了简称是灵车外，这法器对郑常来说没有任何缺点。
东西虽然好，但一千下品灵石自己肯定是拿不出来的。
所以，这车不是郑常买的，是别人送的。
晏城待着最后那两天，郑常在城中当街溜子玩乐了一番。
虽然还是没有打破道德底线进入勾栏听曲，却也去逛了不少地方。
闲逛着，就到了灵宝商会。
本来想的是采购点物资，然后顺便看一下抽奖得到的那瓶解毒丹值多少灵石。
谁知道刚走进灵宝商会呢，还没买什么，就被店员恭喜了。
自己莫名其妙的就成了第十万个进入灵宝商会的额幸运顾客了。
然后商会姓周的管事就出来了，亲自送出了这辆“灵车”。
本来听说这车叫“灵车”，郑常还不想要呢。
但见识这车的配置，郑常觉得，这叫灵车也无所谓啦，又不是叫棺材，文化差异嘛，修仙界的灵车有没有歧义。
不过郑常可不信，自己有这么好的运气。
从领了奖之后，那周管事执意要拉着自己闲聊就能猜到。
周管事一金丹修士，和自己这个炼气期有什么好聊的？还聊了半个时辰？
毕竟是晏城里掰着指头都能数的清的金丹期，相互之间指定有交情。
估计这周管事是从城主秦铁心那里打听到自己和风龙族有关系，想来为未来和风龙族搭个关系。又不好太明显直接送东西给自己，只好整了这出中奖戏码，
郑常也没办法，只能决口不提风龙，给对方开了些日后有能力了一定不忘恩情的空头支票。
收到车的第二天，谷婷也给他找到了一些特殊筑基材料的情报。
到底是一等衙差，还是能力还行的，甚至规划好了路线。
看着谷婷的黑眼圈，郑常怀疑对方是熬了几天大夜给他整理的。
得到谷婷的情报后，郑常就出发离开晏城了。
再待下去，他怕再中点什么。
这车速度不算快，也就和一般马车相当吧，肯定是比不了什么飞行法器的，但也够了。
自己又不是赶路，路上的风景还是要看的嘛！
“常哥，要不你还是启动自动行驶功能吧。”
content_en:
Zheng Chang lay in the car, feeling so comfortable that he wanted to take a nap.
The spirit stone drives the magic vehicle! Produced by Lingbao Chamber of Commerce.
With semi-intelligent and fully autonomous driving, you can set the route in advance, or set the automatic cruise mode to randomly select possible roads on the map.
It will identify dangerous road conditions and notify the user. It has an emergency defense mode that can withstand attacks from foundation-building monks within a certain period of time and protect the user's safety.
The energy consumption is low. The cruise mode consumes no more than five spiritual stones per day. The defense mode operates at full power and only consumes fifteen spiritual stones per hour.
It can operate with spiritual stones, but it can also operate without spiritual stones and relies on the supply of spiritual energy from monks.
The entire vehicle can be stored in a medium-sized storage bag, so you don’t have to worry about finding a parking space.
Comfortable accessories and strong shock absorption make your travels easy and comfortable.
The whole car’s landing price is only one thousand low-grade spiritual stones, making it the best value for money.
It can be said that apart from the abbreviation of being a hearse, this magical instrument has no shortcomings for Zheng Chang.
Although the stuff is good, I definitely can’t get a thousand low-grade spiritual stones by myself.
Therefore, this car was not bought by Zheng Chang, but was given as a gift by someone else.
During the last two days of his stay in Yancheng, Zheng Chang had some fun wandering around the city.
Although I still didn’t break my moral bottom line and went to Goulan to listen to music, I did go to many places.
After wandering around, we arrived at Lingbao Chamber of Commerce.
What I originally wanted to do was to purchase some supplies, and then take a look at how much spiritual stones the bottle of detoxification pill obtained through the lottery was worth.
Who would have thought that when I first walked into Lingbao Chamber of Commerce, I was congratulated by the clerk before I even bought anything.
Inexplicably, I became the 100,000th lucky customer to enter the Lingbao Chamber of Commerce.
Then the steward of the Chamber of Commerce named Zhou came out and personally delivered the "hearse".
I originally heard that this car was called a "hearse", but Zheng Chang didn't want it yet.
But seeing the configuration of this car, Zheng Chang felt that it didn't matter if it was called a hearse, not a coffin. There were cultural differences, and there was no ambiguity in the hearse in the world of immortality.
But Zheng Chang didn't believe that he had such good luck.
You can guess it from the fact that the manager insisted on chatting with me that week after receiving the award.
Manager Zhou is a golden elixir cultivator. What can he and I have to talk about during this Qi refining period? We chatted for half an hour?
After all, they were in the golden elixir period that Yan Cheng could count on his fingers, and they were destined to have friendship with each other.
It is estimated that the steward this week found out from the city lord Qin Tiexin that he has a relationship with the Wind Dragon Clan, and wanted to establish a relationship with the Wind Dragon Clan in the future. I didn’t want to be too obvious about giving something to myself, so I had no choice but to play the winning trick.
Zheng Chang had no choice but to say nothing about Feng Long, and wrote some empty promises to the other party that he would not forget his kindness when he became capable in the future.
The day after receiving the car, Gu Ting also found information about some special foundation building materials for him.
After all, is he a first-class cadre? He is still capable and has even planned a route.
Looking at the dark circles under Gu Ting's eyes, Zheng Chang suspected that the other party stayed up for several days to sort them out for him.
After getting Gu Ting's information, Zheng Chang set out to leave Yancheng.
If he stayed any longer, he was afraid of getting hit with something else.
The speed of this car is not very fast, it is about the same as an ordinary carriage. It is definitely not as fast as some flying magic weapon, but it is enough.
I am not in a hurry, but I still have to see the scenery on the road!
"Brother Chang, why don't you activate the automatic driving function."
